paragraphs: One of the fields in modern history with the quickest rate of growth is computer science and engineering. It is currently the most important industry in the world despite having only a few decades of history.

With the rapid advancement of technology, computer science has revolutionized nearly every aspect of human life — from communication and healthcare to transportation, education, and entertainment. The demand for innovative solutions and intelligent systems continues to surge, fueling the need for skilled professionals in software development, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and data science.

For many young enthusiasts, a career in computer science and engineering has proven to be a worthwhile direction, offering not only financial stability but also opportunities to shape the future. This trend is expected to continue well into the next millennium, as our dependency on digital systems deepens and new technological frontiers emerge, such as quantum computing, robotics, and augmented reality.

We are the top computer science engineering institutions in Kothagudem thanks to the two UG programmes offered by the CSE Department, which was founded in 2008 and has a yearly intake of 90 students for B.TECH (CSE), 60 students for B.TECH (AI & ML),60 Students for B.TECH CSE(DS), and 120 students for Diploma.

The Department has alumni located all over the world.

title: About Placement
meta_description: We offers our students maximum number of opportunities for Placements in top companies.
paragraphs: The institute has a fully functional Training and Placement Cell, and by inviting numerous firms to the Institute for placements, it can offer campus positions to our young, aspiring engineers. Multinational corporations have given the Institute its approval to put students based on their academic performance and the infrastructure that is provided for the aspiring engineers’ complete development.

The Institute refreshes the curriculum by shifting societal needs and offers quality instruction. It has the best college placements in Telangana. Without educational field trips to industry and a time of training in prestigious engineering establishments to solidify the ideas they have learned in regular classrooms and laboratory instruction, we believe that a student’s preparation for a career in engineering is incomplete.

These facts have been taken into account as the T&P cell has formed its relationship with the sector. In addition, we organise brief training courses in collaboration with reputable national organisations.The institute is confident enough to invite engineering groups to assess the professional competence of its graduates.

Based on the qualitative needs of the hiring organisation, the institute can screen and narrow down a pool of candidates. The cell wants to place 100% of the qualified students from the present branches throughout the current academic year.

title: Admission Process and Guidelines
meta_description: ADMISSION PROCESS & GUIDE LINES ADMISSION PROCESS AND GUIDE LINES The primary entrance exam for engineering admissions in Telangana is the Telangana Engineering, Agriculture and Pharmacy (Veterinary etc.,) Common Entrance Test (TG EAPCET), also known as EAMCET. Admissions are primarily based on merit in this exam, with a portion of seats reserved for management/NRI candidates
paragraphs: The primary entrance exam for engineering admissions in Telangana is the Telangana Engineering, Agriculture and Pharmacy (Veterinary etc.,) Common Entrance Test (TG EAPCET), also known as EAMCET. Admissions are primarily based on merit in this exam, with a portion of seats reserved for management/NRI candidates and other categories like EWS and diploma holders. Detailed Process:

1. Eligibility:Candidates must have passed their 10+2 (Intermediate) examination with Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry as optional subjects.Specific eligibility criteria may vary for management/NRI quotas, and other categories like EWS and diploma holders. 2. Entrance Exam:The main entrance exam is the TG-EAPCET.Candidates need to apply online through the official website during the application window.The process includes registration, filling details, uploading documents, and paying the application fee. 3. Counseling and Seat Allotment:After the TG-EAPCET results are released, candidates are called for counseling conducted by the convener.Seat allotment is based on merit rank in the EAMCET, subject to any reservations.Counseling is typically held in multiple rounds.

4. Documents Required:• TS EAPCET Rank Card.• TS EAPCET Admit Card.• Intermediate Mark Sheet &Transfer Certificate.• 4th to 12th Study Certificates.• Class 10th Certificate.• Domicile Certificate (if required).• Caste Certificate (if required).• Counseling Fee Payment Receipt.• Income Certificate (if required).• Aadhar Card

Additional Information: Lateral Entry:Diploma holders can be admitted to the second year of B.Tech through a lateral entry scheme based on their merit in the Engineering Common Entrance Test (ECET),. Reservations:The government of Telangana provides various reservations for different categories like SC, ST, EWS, etc.,. Management Quota:A certain percentage of seats is reserved for management/NRI candidates.

There is a robust, active alumni network for AKITS that spans the entire world. Everyone connected to AKITS benefits greatly from this thriving alumni network, which raises brand awareness, fosters possibilities for current students and provides guidance.

While the Abdul Kalam College in Kothagudem experience begins on campus, we firmly believe that it lasts a lifetime. The alumni association is crucial in forging enduring connections and fostering comradery among a worldwide group.

title: IIC
meta_description: The Institution-Industry cell Committee was constituted for the academic session.
paragraphs: An Institution-Industry Cell Committee, or similar, is a group within an educational institution that focuses on strengthening the relationship between the institution and industry. The goal is to bridge the gap between academic learning and real-world industry needs, enhancing student employability and fostering innovation.

Key Functions and Objectives:Bridging the Gap:The cell aims to identify and address the differences between academic curriculum and industry requirements, ensuring students are prepared for the workforce.Industry-Academia Collaboration:It facilitates interactions and collaborations between the institution and industry, including guest lectures, workshops, and industrial visits.Industry-Ready Students:The cell helps students gain practical experience, learn industry-specific skills, and develop a strong understanding of current industry practices.Faculty Development:It can also provide opportunities for faculty to stay updated on industry trends and best practices.Research and Development:The cell may facilitate sponsored research projects and other collaborations that benefit both the institution and industry.Entrepreneurship and Innovation:Some cells also focus on fostering entrepreneurship and innovation among students, potentially through competitions and mentorship programs.Networking and Partnerships:The cell can build and maintain relationships with industry professionals and organizations, creating a network for students and faculty.Aligning Curriculum:The cell works to ensure the curriculum is aligned with industry needs and expectations, making it more relevant and practical.

meta_description: Internal Compliant Committee Internal Complaints Committees (ICCs) are mandated to handle complaints of sexual harassment at the workplace, ensuring a safe and respectful environment. These committees are responsible for investigating complaints, providing a fair hearing to both the complainant and respondent, and implementing recommendations. The ICC must complete its investigation within 90 days of receiving the
paragraphs: Internal Complaints Committees (ICCs) are mandated to handle complaints of sexual harassment at the workplace, ensuring a safe and respectful environment. These committees are responsible for investigating complaints, providing a fair hearing to both the complainant and respondent, and implementing recommendations. The ICC must complete its investigation within 90 days of receiving the complaint, with a 60-day timeframe for implementing recommendations.

Key aspects of ICC guidelines:• Composition:ICCs typically consist of a presiding officer (a senior woman employee), two employee members (preferably with social work or legal knowledge), and an external member from a non-governmental organization or association committed to women’s issues.• Complaint Procedure:Complaints can be made in written form or by email, within three months of the incident or last incident in a series.• Inquiry Process:The ICC conducts a thorough investigation, providing opportunities for the complainant and respondent to present their case.• Timelines:The Act sets specific timelines for the ICC’s actions, including the submission of complaints, notice to the respondent, completion of the inquiry, and implementation of recommendations.• Protection against Retaliation:The Act prohibits retaliation against the complainant or witnesses for filing a complaint.• Confidentiality:ICCs strive to maintain confidentiality of the complaint and the identities of the parties involved.• Consequences of Harassment:If found guilty, the offender may face penalties, including financial penalties or termination of employment.• Regular Meetings and Reporting:ICCs are expected to hold regular meetings and prepare quarterly or annual reports on the status of complaints.• Awareness and Sensitization:ICCs should conduct sensitization programs and workshops to educate employees about their rights and the importance of a harassment-free workplace.

paragraphs: ABDUL KALAM INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGICAL SCIENCES (AKITS) has promoted meaningful scientific industrial Research and Development activities with a vision and mission to pursue and promote Research in Frontier Technologies as well as in the various disciplines of Engineering. For any education, specifically technical education, the basic model of a ‘teaching – only’ institution is inadequate to ensure quality education. In all disciplines of technical education, knowledge is dynamic with new technologies being introduced very frequently. In this scenario, it is not possible for the teachers to deliver good quality instructions without being tuned to the current developments in the subjects, for which they must constantly update their knowledge. A well-recognized way to deal with this paradigm is for the teachers to be active researchers in the areas in which they interested. As researchers, they need to understand the past and recent developments in their subject areas.

Research and Development cell was established at AKITS to inculcate research and innovative skills among faculty and students. R&D Cell provides a platform for creativity and innovation to flourish young minds in Institute. Innovative breakthroughs will happen only because of meticulous efforts of R&D. The Institute provides SEED amount to facilitate basic common research infrastructure for individuals to execute collaborative work.AKITS R&D cell is a nominated committee consisting of Professors from various programs of Engineering. title: Placement Activities
meta_description: We Conduct So many Placement Drives and activities for our students to get a better job in reputed company
paragraphs: Final placements at the best educational institutions are the product of extremely methodical interactions between the business community and the students, as well as ongoing career counselling. Students get ongoing career guidance from the outset of the programme, and this guidance is rigorously followed up with potential employers to secure their participation in the Institute’s placement programme. In addition to assisting the students in landing their “dream employment,” this also helps the visiting placement organisations find the “best” applicant for their business.

title: Training Activities
meta_description: We conduct Traning activities for our student to get better in every aspect of their learning
paragraphs: As we move forward with this academic year (2007–2008), Abdul Kalam college in Kothagudem is developing a strong Training and Placement/HR team to help place our future students and engineers. By sponsoring them during their semester breaks, students are exposed to the industry and outside environment in addition to the university-framed academics. By encouraging them to sponsor programmes like industrial seminars, entrepreneurship development programmes, organising seminars by corporate executives and eminent academicians, and coaching them for GATE, GRE, GMAT, and TOFEL, among other things, the Training and Placement Department at Abdul Kalam Institute of Technological Sciences also plays a crucial role in the career development of the students.

items: Our Training and Placement divison will also engages campus placement interviews from various industries organisations for final year students of all branches of Engineering students.

To meet the growing demand of quality teachers Engineering colleges Training and Placement divison also identifies students who are interested in teaching career and forwarding them to early induction programme conducted by AICTE, New Delhi.
The Department receives guidence from the senior faculty members of the college and also advisors from external professional bodies and leading HRD consultants.
The rapidly advancing technological innovations around the world push educational institutions to shape college-admitted pupils to make them stand out in a cutthroat environment.
In addition to university coursework, the Abdulkalam Institute of Technological Sciences offers courses that are career-focused according to the area of study.
The orientation programmes force the student to learn about related engineering disciplines to meet industry requirements.
The GRE, TOEFL, GATE, and other competitive tests are among those for which students are trained by a separate cell of the Bureau of Higher Studies.
By financing them for seminars held by various institutes and organisations as well as by hosting monthly seminars on campus, students are also encouraged to improve their communication abilities.
Depending on their interests and preferences, students can study on separate computers with a variety of CD-ROM titles spanning technical and general knowledge.
